name: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing the Mountain Dwarf
prereqQuests: Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest

steps.text: Head to the Rising Sun Inn pub in Falador.

Ask Emily about dwarves and ale (wear Ring of charos (a) if you have it).
  • If wearing Ring of charos (a):

actions.text: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?
I could offer you some in return, how about 200 gold?
What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?
(Persuade)I'm really quite trustworthy once you get to know me.

steps.text: Head to The Pick and Lute pub in Taverley.
Add 1 gold coin to each glass of ale. (you can take coins out of your money pouch by right clicking the price checker in your inventory and selecting withdraw)
Head to the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain (cave north of Taverley lodestone).
Talk to the Old Dwarf, Rohak. You must finish this dialogue to proceed.

Use 4 Asgoldian ales on him and then after the fade, talk to him. You may need to repeat this process if you either: exit the cave before the next step, or do not give him the four ales quickly enough.
Talk to Rohak again to give him one-hundred coins, a bucket of milk, an egg, a pot of flour, and a bowl of water.

Quickly pick up the Dwarven rock cake whilst wearing gloves.
  • If the cake is not picked up fast enough, the ingredients are required to make another one.

Cooling the cake:
  • If ice gloves were worn whilst picking up the cake, simply return to Lumbridge.
  • If ice gloves were not worn, either drop the cake and pick it up with ice gloves equipped or kill an icefiend with it in your inventory.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Use the cooled rock cake on the Dwarf.
